# Go agent skills

Vendored from [samber/cc-skills-golang](https://github.com/samber/cc-skills-golang)
at commit `30cdf15cde8db8730c42a2918d7cdb4505f5ff54`.

This repository includes the upstream general-purpose Go skills and the
`golang-spf13-cobra` skill used by autofeat. Framework- and library-specific
